newsitem.title: SPAIN: CNMV says Ducde share offer for Bilbainas complete.
newsitem.headline: CNMV says Ducde share offer for Bilbainas complete.

text.p: The Spanish Stock Market Commission CNMV said on Monday 79.32 percent of shares of winemaker Bodegas Bilbainas were tendered to Ducde in its share offer.
The amount of share tendered, 633,227 shares, surpassed the 407,123 minimum required, the CNMV said.
Ducde is a unit of Cava sparkling wine producers Codorniu.
"As a result the share offer has had a positive result given that the number of acceptances were above the minimum fixed by the company offering," the CNMV said.
